title: Orchestrate dual-path smokechecks with late-fail backstop and adaptive sampling
author: Lena Ortiz
description:
Motivation: some prompt-sets intermittently fail CI due to transient model noise and dataset order sensitivity. This PR adds a dual-path smokecheck orchestration pattern: a deterministic fast-path smokecheck for strict regressions and a probabilistic background path (shadow-run) that collects soft signals and surfaces intermittent regressions. The two paths converge to a late-fail backstop that can block merges if aggregated soft signals cross configurable thresholds.

What this PR includes: 
- new orchestrator: eval_harness/orchestrators/dual_path_orchestrator.py (manages fast and shadow paths, sampling rates, and escalation policy)
- CI hook definition: ci/hooks/dual_path_smokecheck.yaml (integrates with GitHub Actions, exposes thresholds and sampling knobs)
- adaptive reservoir sampler: eval_harness/samplers/reservoir_sampler.py (keeps bounded sample for long-running shadow runs)
- metric aggregator: eval_harness/metrics/soft_signal_aggregator.py (computes weighted failure score, variance, and staleness penalties)
- integration tests: tests/integration/test_dual_path_orchestrator.py and smokegrid test fixtures
- docs: docs/eval/dual-path-smokechecks.md with examples and runbook

Checklist:
- [x] Fast-path deterministic asserts implemented and covered by unit tests
- [x] Shadow-run sampling + reservoir retention implemented and integration-tested against a small model stub
- [x] CI hook emits actionable annotations and summary metadata (scan job artifacts)
- [x] Linear tasks updated (ENG-3121)

Backward compatibility: the fast-path defaults to previous single-path behavior when shadow sampling disabled. The new config keys are optional and safe for existing pipelines.

How to exercise locally: see docs/eval/dual-path-smokechecks.md; quick command: 
python -m eval_harness.orchestrators.dual_path_orchestrator --config ci/hooks/dual_path_smokecheck.yaml --local-stub

Notes: thresholds tuned conservatively (low false-positive rate). We plan to run this in shadow mode for two weeks before enabling strict blocking on the late-fail backstop.
